target.title: fix(ui): add workboard detail drawer actions
target.body:
﻿Closes #99957

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Workboard users could open a card detail drawer but lose access to the card actions that are available on compact cards, including moving, editing, archiving, deleting, and opening the linked session.

## Why This Change Was Made

The detail drawer now reuses the same Workboard card action rendering as compact cards, so action guards stay aligned between the two surfaces. This follow-up also pins the action helper return type so Lit's `nothing` sentinel remains `typeof nothing` instead of widening to a plain `symbol` in the shared action slots. The change keeps the board-name filter request out of scope and does not alter the existing crowded-column scroll behavior.

## User Impact

Users can manage a Workboard card from the expanded detail drawer without closing it and returning to the compact card surface.

## Evidence

Head SHA: `809522c368cf0d0e9bf437f19d0bdf4cf21ed254`

- Claim proved: Workboard detail drawer renders the same guarded move/open/stop/edit/archive/delete action row while the shared helper keeps action slot content typed as `TemplateResult | typeof nothing`.
- Commands:
  - `git diff --check` - passed.
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/workboard/view.test.ts ui/src/pages/workboard/view.browser.test.ts` - passed: 2 files, 71 tests.
  - `PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH="C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe" node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.ui-e2e.config.ts --configLoader runner ui/src/pages/workboard/workboard.e2e.test.ts` - passed: 1 file, 2 tests.
- Browser proof artifact: https://gist.github.com/qingminglong/c44211f4c28642711123dc19df3634fe contains `05-detail-actions.svg`, showing the mocked Control UI Workboard detail drawer with the move/open/edit/archive/delete action row visible, plus the generated E2E manifest.
- Observed result: the focused render/browser tests pass and the mocked Gateway browser E2E opens the Workboard detail drawer, asserts Open session/Edit card/Archive card/Delete card controls, captures the visible detail-actions screenshot, then continues through move/lifecycle/read-only flows.

Related PR state:
- #100319 is open for the same issue but currently carries `status: needs proof`; this PR includes focused render/browser tests plus mocked Gateway browser E2E proof on the current head.

Not tested / proof gaps:
- No live production Gateway was used; the browser proof uses the repository's mocked Gateway E2E harness.
